title: The sixteen-week design engagement, phase by phase
subtitle: Coding the corpus took the longest single block, because the taxonomy had to be argued before anything could be counted.
note: Three of the sixteen weeks went on the decomposition, which is the analysis that redirected the whole programme.
source: Timeline as stated in this case study: weeks 1 to 5, 6 to 8, 9 to 12 and 13 to 16.
